name: daily
title_zh: 早晨读三份清单，只给你今天该做的三件事
tagline_zh: 不想再被消息流牵着走？它先翻 GOALS、BACKLOG 和 tasks/，再给你三件优先级最高的事。
tagline_en: Tired of being dragged by notifications? It reads GOALS, BACKLOG & tasks/, then hands you 3 top priorities, each.
desc_en: Start-of-day planning routine — reads GOALS.md, BACKLOG.md, and open tasks/, then proposes today's top 3 priorities with a verification plan each. Use when the user wants to start their day or plan what to work on. Trigger words include "daily", "start my day", "เริ่มวัน", "วันนี้ทำอะไรดี".
why_zh: 不是待办清单生成器，而是把长期目标和积压任务压成每日三件事的决策器。验证计划逼你定义'做完'。
why_en: Not a to-do list generator—it compresses long-term goals & backlog into 3 daily picks, each with a 'done' check. Kills fake.
limit_zh: 只认 GOALS.md、BACKLOG.md 和 tasks/ 目录，缺一个就罢工。不读日历、不读邮件、不读聊天记录。
limit_en: Only reads GOALS.md, BACKLOG.md & tasks/ dir; missing one = refuses. Ignores calendar, email, chats. Outputs suggestions only—no execution or.
title_en: Morning reads 3 lists, proposes today's top 3 tasks
